Residency by Investment

An international hub offering abundant investment opportunities, complemented by tax-free personal income and a safe, stable, high-quality living environment.

Program
Overview

UAE is a leading global hub for business, trade, and investment, renowned for its strategic location connecting East and West. The city offers world-class infrastructure, a tax-efficient environment, and a stable, pro-business regulatory framework. In addition, UAE provides access to high-quality international education and direct pathways to top universities around the world. Combined with a high standard of living, exceptional safety, and a dynamic lifestyle, UAE continues to attract investors, entrepreneurs, and global talent.

Eligibility Criteria

  1. Main Applicant

    • At least 18 years of age
    • No criminal record
    • Fulfills investment requirements

  2. Eligibility of Dependents

    • Spouse(s)
    • Children of any age
    • Domestic staff

Key Benefits

  • High standard of living, exceptional safety
  • Education with direct access to top universities around the world
  • Global hub with abundant investment opportunities
  • No personal income and minimum business taxation
